scripts.title: OnyxHub
scripts.features:
BEST INVISIBLE FE SCRIPT HUB - ONYX

This script includes an Invisible GUI that lets you toggle invisibility ON/OFF, with a clean, draggable interface!

Features:

Invisible Mode — Toggle invisibility on or off through the GUI or by pressing G. Your character becomes partially transparent, with additional positioning behavior designed to make you harder to see..
No-Collide Feature — Disables local collision for other characters while invisibility is enabled.
Modern GUI — Clean design with smooth animations, toggle effects, and notifications.
Minimize & Restore — Minimize the GUI into a floating sphere and tap it to restore the main panel.
Draggable Interface — Move the main GUI and minimized sphere wherever you want.
Close Confirmation — Confirm before closing the GUI.
Respawn Handling — Resets the invisibility state when your character respawns.

Alpha means this script is an early development version. It may still have bugs, incomplete features, or unexpected behavior. More improvements, fixes, and changes may come in future updates.

How to Use:

1. Execute the script.
2. Press the toggle in the GUI or press G to activate/deactivate invisibility.
3. Stand up before enabling invisibility if your character is seated.
4. Minimize the GUI whenever you want a smaller interface.

Notice this script still Alpha A few Bugs may unexpectedly Appear.
